restore.description: Overwrites the attached coordinator with a stored network backup. Dry run by default: reports what would happen and raises a notification without changing anything.

file.description: File name from list_backups. Defaults to the newest.

mode.description: Dry run only checks; restore performs it.

force.name: Force
force.description: Proceed even if the pre-flight reports a blocking problem. For Silicon Labs radios this also permits a one-time IEEE overwrite.
